docs.title: BDC Variable Library
docs.text: A LinkML-based variable library for BioData Catalyst datasets.

docs.title: Background
docs.text: BDC Variable Library (BDCVL) groups related variables into a single LinkML slot per concept, so atrial fibrillation (MONDO:0004981) is one slot with a comma-delimited source_study / dataset_accession / variable_accession annotation, rather than separate near-duplicate records per study. Concepts are grouped into classes that follow the BioData Catalyst Harmonized Model (BDCHM), spanning all contributing BioData Catalyst studies.

docs.title: Classes
docs.text:
Each class is a BDCHM class, with its own module, and its slots are the concepts derived as that class. Counts per class and per study are on the Stats page.

Class Concept identified by Module Condition condition_concept bdc_varlib_condition.yaml MeasurementObservation observation_type bdc_varlib_measurement_observation.yaml Observation observation_type bdc_varlib_observation.yaml SdohObservation observation_type bdc_varlib_sdoh_observation.yaml DrugExposure drug_concept bdc_varlib_drug_exposure.yaml Procedure procedure_concept bdc_varlib_procedure.yaml

Use the Schema tab to browse every class and slot.

docs.title: From class to concept to variable
docs.text:
The library has three levels:

Level LinkML construct Example Class class Condition Concept slot, named after its ontology code mondo_0004981 (afib) Variable annotation entries on a slot one dbGaP phv / pht pair

A concept's slot records every contributing study, and each study can have several dbGaP variables behind it (one per exam wave, hospital form, or follow-up survey). Those are stored as comma-delimited lists in the slot's annotations rather than as separate slots. For atrial fibrillation:

mondo_0004981:
  title: afib
  range: ConditionStatusEnum
  annotations:
    concept_id: MONDO:0004981
    concept_name: afib
    bdchm_class: Condition
    source_study: ARIC, CHS, COPDGene, FHS, HCHS, JHS, MESA, WHI
    dataset_accession: pht004037, pht004038, pht004039, ...
    variable_accession: phv00203303, phv00203306, phv00203309, ...
    source_file: ARIC-ingest/afib.yaml, CHS-ingest/afib.yaml, ...
  exact_mappings:
  - MONDO:0004981

One slot pools many dbGaP datasets and variables from several cohorts into a single concept. The Schema tab lists the full dataset_accession and variable_accession lists on each slot page.

docs.title: Concept names
docs.text: Slots are identified by ontology code (concept_id, also in exact_mappings). The concept_name shown next to it is currently taken from the source file name (for example afib, hist_cor_angio) and will be replaced with ontology labels in a later release.

docs.title: Structure
docs.text:
• bdc_varlib.yaml: the umbrella schema; imports every class module.
  • bdc_varlib_common.yaml: enums shared across classes (for example ConditionStatusEnum), so every module is self-contained and can be loaded standalone, not only via the umbrella.
  • bdc_varlib_<class>.yaml: one module per BDCHM class.

docs.title: Provenance
docs.text: Every slot's annotations record exactly which studies, dbGaP datasets (pht), and dbGaP variables (phv) it was derived from, and the source file it came from. The concept code (MONDO, OBA, OMOP, RxCUI, ATC, HP and others) is carried through as a LinkML exact_mappings entry.
